title: Lord, Dismiss Us with Thy Blessing
description: Lord, Dismiss Us with Thy Blessing in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 3 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by John Fawcett and Godfrey Thring, first published in 1773. The tune, REGENT SQUARE, is by Henry Thomas Smart (1867). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Lord, dis-miss us with Thy bless-ing; Fill our hearts with joy and peace; Let us each Thy love pos-ses-sing, Tri-umph in re_-deem-ing grace. O re-fresh us, O re-fresh us, Trav'-ling through this wil-der-ness.

lines: Lord, dismiss us with Thy blessing;
Fill our hearts with joy and peace;
Let us each Thy love possessing,
O refresh us, O refresh us,
May the fruits of Thy salvation
In our hearts and lives abound.
To the truth may we be found.
So that when Thy love shall call us,
Fear of death shall not appall us,
May we ever, may we ever,
Reign with Thee in endless day.
